description: This file is a CMake script used to locate and configure the Nexus client library within a build system. It attempts to find the Nexus client headers and library, and sets up imported targets accordingly, including handling error messages if the library is not found.

methods.name: find_path
methods.description: Searches for the specified header file in the system include paths with optional suffixes.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Searches for the specified library file in the system library paths.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes another CMake script or module.

methods.name: find_package_handle_standard_args
methods.description: Handles the standard logic for processing the results of find_package-like commands.

methods.name: mark_as_advanced
methods.description: Marks variables as advanced to hide them in GUIs.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Creates a new library target, possibly imported.

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Sets properties for a target, such as include directories and link interface.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Displays a message during CMake configuration, can be status or fatal error.
